blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A shipment is on the way. Everybody asks the same question: where is it? Tracking gives the answer. Every shipment has a number, a map and a status.

Today you learn 5 important words: shipment, tracking, status, location, and ETA. ETA means Estimated Time of Arrival. We start slow. You can do it!

When a customer calls, you check the tracking. Then you answer with a place. A short answer is good: "It is in Santos." A clear location builds trust. Customers love updates.

items.q: What question does everybody ask about a shipment?
items.why: "Everybody asks the same question: where is it?"

items.q: What does ETA mean?
items.why: "ETA means Estimated Time of Arrival."

items.q: How many important words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn 5 important words."

items.q: The text says "A clear location builds trust." This suggests that…
options: customers trust you more when you give a clear place
trust has no link to tracking
items.why: Inferência: uma localização clara faz o cliente confiar mais em você.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a long, difficult answer is best
you should not answer the customer
a short, clear answer is good
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia respostas curtas e claras ("A short answer is good").

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ana, do time de logística, atender um cliente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! This is Ana from logistics. Thank you for your call. You want to know where your shipment is. No problem. I can help you.

Let me check the tracking now. One moment, please. I have your number here. Okay, I can see it. Your shipment is in Santos. That is the location today.

The status is "in transit." This means the box is on the way. It is not at your office yet, but it is close.

The ETA is tomorrow morning. ETA means Estimated Time of Arrival. So your shipment arrives tomorrow, around nine o'clock.

Is there anything else? No? Great. I will send you an update by email tonight. If you have more questions, please call again. We love to help. Have a good day. Goodbye!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "This is Ana from logistics."

items.q: Where is the shipment today?
items.why: "Your shipment is in Santos. That is the location today."

items.q: What is the ETA?
items.why: "The ETA is tomorrow morning… around nine o'clock."

items.q: The status is "in transit." This suggests that…
options: the shipment is still on the way
items.why: Inferência: "in transit" e "on the way" mostram que a remessa ainda está viajando.

items.q: How would you best describe Ana's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela agradece, oferece ajuda e diz "We love to help" — tom simpático.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The shipment arrives on Monday." A shipment is…
options: a goods delivery on the way
items.why: Shipment = remessa: os produtos que estão sendo enviados.

items.q: "I use tracking to find the box." Tracking is…
options: a way to follow where something is
items.why: Tracking = rastreamento: seguir onde algo está.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ of the shipment is 'in transit'."
items.why: Status = situação atual da remessa (ex.: "in transit").

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ today is Santos, near the port."
items.why: Location = localização, o lugar onde a remessa está.

items.q: "The ETA is tomorrow at nine." ETA tells you…
items.why: ETA = Estimated Time of Arrival: quando a remessa deve chegar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The box is on the way." This means it is…
items.why: On the way = a caminho, ainda viajando.

items.q: "I will check on the shipment." To check on something is to…
options: look and see how it is
items.why: Check on = verificar, ver como algo está.

items.q: "Please hold on a moment." Hold on means…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento.

items.q: "I will get back to you tonight." This means I will…
items.why: Get back to you = retornar o contato mais tarde.

items.q: "The shipment will show up tomorrow." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar.
